header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: fall from a dry tree on a day when the wind blows hard, the sins of both of them fall away; the sins of both of them are forgiven, even if their sins are as abundant as the foam of the sea!” Hazrat Salman Farsi (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ عَنَزَةَ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ اَنَّهُ قَالَ لِأَبِيْ ذَرٍّ: هَلْ كَانَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ يُصَافِحُكُمْ اِذا لَقِيْتُمُوْهُ؟ قَالَ: مَا لَقِيْتُهُ قَطُّ اِلَّا صَافَحَنِيْ، وَبَعَثَ اِلَيَّ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ وَلَمْ اَكُنْ فِيْ اَهْلِيْ، فَلَمَّا جِئْتُ اُخْبِرْتُ اَنَّهُ اَرْسَلَ اِلَيَّ فَاَتَيْتُهُ وَهُوَ عَلَي سَرِيْرِهِ، فَالْتَزَمَنِيْ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ اَجْوَدَ وَاَجْوَدَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب في المعانقة رقم:٥٢١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: “A man from the tribe of Anazah narrates: “I asked Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA), “When you met Rasulullah ﷺ, would he do Musafahah (shake hands) with you?”” Hazrat Abu Dharr (RA) replied: “Whenever I met Rasulullah ﷺ, he would do Musafahah with me. One day the Prophet ﷺ sent someone to my house to call me, and at that time I was not at home. When I returned, I was told that the Prophet ﷺ had sent someone to call me. I came into the presence of the Prophet ﷺ; at that time the Prophet ﷺ was sitting on a bed, and the Prophet ﷺ embraced me. The Prophet ﷺ embracing me (and doing Mu'anaqah) was very good! It was very good indeed!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ سَاَلَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ: يَارَسُوْلَ اللهِ! اَسْتَاْذِنُ عَلَي اُمِّيْ؟ فَقَالَ: نَعَمْ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ: اِنِّيْ مَعهَا فِي الْبَيْتِ، فَقَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اِسْتَاْذِنْ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ:
